name: ImageGlass
price: Classic free; Pro Individual $14.90 one-time, Pro Team $69 one-time (3 users), Pro Business by volume (from $290/year for 25 users)
license: GPL-3.0 (Classic); Pro under a commercial licence
summary: Fast open-source image viewer, rebuilt in v10 on .NET/Avalonia for Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux. Strong format coverage (90+ incl. RAW, JXL, HEIC, AVIF, HDR, native SVG), smart caching, themes, custom hotkeys and codec plugins. It is a single-image viewer with a gallery strip, not a folder browser, and plays no videos.
where_it_wins: Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux with one codebase
HDR tone mapping for AVIF, JPEG XL, HDR and EXR
Codec plugin SDK for extra formats
Built-in crop, resize and colour picker
Custom hotkeys in the free edition
where_schnellbild_wins: Plays videos (MKV, AVI, WebM via VLC) in the same grid as photos
Archives and comics (ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ/CBR) open like folders
Folder grid with folder previews, list view, recursive and regex search
Dual pane with move/copy and undo
Slideshow through subfolders mixing photos and videos
App Sandbox, never goes online, build attestation
No paid tier: every feature free

free.note: Classic is free (GPLv3); Pro $14.90 one-time adds HDR Tone Mapper, free panning, File Watcher, mouse click actions, managed deployment

open_source.note: ImageGlass Classic under GPLv3; Pro is the same codebase with a paid licence

native_apple_silicon.note: v10: macOS 14+, Apple silicon arm64 DMG, AOT-compiled .NET/Avalonia

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account (Pro licensing is account-free); the app checks for updates online (AutoUpdate setting)

dark_light_setting.note: Follows the system; a theme pack is chosen for dark and one for light mode, so the same pack can be set for both

folder_browsing.note: Opens a file or folder and pages through that folder's images; no folder tree, no navigating into subfolders

thumbnail_grid.note: Gallery of the current folder's images (strip or columns); no folder tiles

list_view.note: No list/details view among the settings

network_shares_fast.note: Off-thread decoding and look-ahead caching; nothing specific to network shares documented

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/HEIF (still), AVIF (animated via AVIF plugin), JXL (still), WebP

img_psd_exr.note: PSD, PSB, EXR (EXR with HDR tone mapping)

img_svg_pdf.note: Native SVG/SVGZ renderer incl. animated SVG; no PDF

img_animated.note: GIF, WebP, SVG; APNG via the APNG plugin

zoom_rotate.note: Six zoom modes, cursor-precise zoom, rotate/flip

slideshow_recursive.note: Can load images from subfolders (EnableSubfoldersLoading); images only, no videos

auto_enhance_view.note: Colour channel view and invert only; no auto enhance

file_info_exif.note: EXIF through the separate ExifGlass tool; no video information

wrong_extension_note.note: Lang.cs holds all UI strings; none for a notice about mismatched extension and content (same on Windows, macOS, Linux)
